compose_claim_shredder.problem: Viral posts about referral and affiliate commissions stretch time-limited rates into “lifetime”, turn “up to” into a per-sale figure, pass off a friend's reward or platform credit as the referrer's cash, splice separate programs or regions together, reuse superseded terms, and keep promoting programs that are closed, capped or geo-excluded. Readers can't check this quickly. Claim Shredder takes one pasted claim and gives each program it names one of four labels, tied to a dated official source, with no earnings math and no codes.
do: Ship one screen: paste box → verdict panel → program board, in that order; no hero, no marketing sections.
Answer with the enumerated output_contract only: program name + label chip + fixed reason line(s) + official source + checked date.
Seed the board with all 15 rows in classifier.seed; show status and checked date once per row, and one sub-line per track with its track label and source link.
Apply the freshness gate: a row gives verdicts other than 未核实 · seed_stale, and shows a join CTA, only while verified_on is within 90 days.

Before launch, open every track's official source, confirm or correct its facts, cmp and unresolved items, then set page_read = true, evidence = official_page_read and verified_on = the reading date. verified_on is the date shown as 核对 / Checked everywhere.
Offer a share line only under share_line.offer_when, from the fixed template that ends with “推荐 · 可能获佣 / may earn a rebate”; leave {own_link} empty for the user.
Put the standing disclosure in the footer of every view and directly above any share line.
Keep everything bilingual: zh primary line, en secondary line in the muted tone; the four labels always appear as label_set with their en gloss.

Look: calm institutional dark board. Tokens: bg #0B0E12, surface #10151B, hairline #1F2630, text #DCE1E8, muted #8C96A4. Outline label chips: 公开规则 #7FAF95, 易误解 #C8A45E, 未核实 #8C96A4, 关门反例 #B97474. Type: IBM Plex Sans + Noto Sans SC, 15/24, tabular numerals for dates.
Board becomes stacked cards below 640px; 16px side gutter; motion limited to a 150ms opacity fade and off under prefers-reduced-motion.
Process pastes in the browser only. No analytics or other network request is sent in response to a paste or a verdict.
dont: No personal take-rate, earnings estimate, calculator or 「你能拿 xx%」 / “you'll earn X” phrasing anywhere.

Never generate, complete, store, or echo from the paste a referral, invite or founder code; never add ref / via / code parameters to any link. The only code-bearing link that may appear is the one the user types into {own_link}.
No join CTA, apply button or referral link on a row that is not open (closed, capped, geo-limited) or is stale.
Don't quote or restate numbers from the paste in the verdict.
No hype vocabulary (see acceptance A1) and no urgency or scarcity UI: countdowns, “spots left”, confetti, glow, gradients, emoji.
Don't present a row as checked while verified_on is null, and never hide its checked date once it has one.
Don't use the gravity.li domain, GRAVITY branding or any vendor's logo or trademark styling; don't imply endorsement.
Don't let a single keyword decide a label across programs; always compare against the matched row and track.
Don't go beyond 未核实 · unknown_program for programs outside the seed.

classifier.mode: Deterministic rules run in the browser. No LLM free text, no network call on paste; the same paste, seed and date always give the same output.
classifier.input: One pasted claim, zh or en, up to 2,000 characters. URLs (/https?:\/\/\S+/g) are stripped before matching and never rendered.
steps: S0 normalize: replace enclosed alphanumerics used as list markers (U+2460–U+24FF, U+3251–U+325F, U+32B1–U+32BF, e.g. ① ⑵ ⒊) with 、; replace the full-width comma ， (U+FF0C) with 、 (U+3001); then NFKC (full-width to half-width), Traditional to Simplified (OpenCC t2s), lowercase Latin, collapse whitespace; then write spelled-out numbers as digits: Chinese numerals [零一二两三四五六七八九十]{1,3} directly before 个月|年|天|% (not after 第 or 首) or directly after 百分之 (两=2, 十二=12, 二十四=24, 四十五=45); English one–twelve, eighteen, twenty-four, thirty, sixty, ninety directly before month(s)|year(s)|day(s)|percent; then 百分之N → N%, 'N percent' / 'N per cent' → N%, 半年 → 6个月, N年半 → (12N+6)个月 (一年半 → 18个月).

S1 match programs: seed[].aliases are regex sources (flags iu) run on the S0 text. None → 未核实 · unknown_program. With several programs, keep the first 3 programs by first alias offset and split the paste at each alias occurrence; each segment belongs to the program whose alias opens it (text before the first alias goes to the first); a segment opened by an alias of a program that was not kept is dropped. A segment whose text after its alias holds only list separators (whitespace / 、 , & + | · 和 与 及 以及 还有 跟 and or) also reads the next segment that holds more than that, when that segment belongs to another kept program, so a claim shared by a list of names (A、B、C 都是…) reaches every listed program. S3–S6 read only that program's segments; S7 reads the whole paste and its codes attach to every verdict.
S2 freshness gate: stale when verified_on is null or (client UTC date − verified_on) > 90 days. Stale → 未核实 · seed_stale and stop for that program.

S3 resolve track: named tracks are the row's tracks whose track_words match. Exactly one → that track. Several named tracks → cut the segment at the start of each of their track_words matches (a match starting inside an earlier match is ignored); each piece is extracted (S4) and compared (S5 step 3) against the track whose word opens it, text before the first cut joins the first piece, and a fact matched in any piece counts as matched; S5 steps 1–2 still read the whole segment. None, or only words for tracks this row lacks → the track with the most matched S5 facts (tie → tracks[0]).

S4 extract facts from the segment with the lexicon: extract ranges first (a rate or amount inside a range span is dropped; a range is one fact {low = its first number, high = its last number} whose high end counts as ceiling-marked; a tier ladder such as 10%→15%→25% is a range); then standalone rates and amounts (ceiling-marked when a ceiling match ends within 8 characters before the number, or ceiling_after matches the text right after the number and its unit; an amount with a threshold match ending within 8 characters before it, or whose following text (after the number and its unit) matches threshold_after, is a threshold fact, not a standalone amount; k or 千 multiplies an amount by 1,000 and 万 by 10,000); durations (each cookie match takes as the cookie window the single nearest duration within 12 characters that has no 、 ; 。 ! ? between it and the cookie word (on a tie, the one after the cookie word); a remaining duration whose following text matches timing_after, or whose preceding text matches timing_before, is payout timing and is skipped; any other duration is the commission duration; first_year = 12 months); and every other lexicon key as a boolean. Drop a lifetime, recurring, cash, guarantee, income, affiliation, cap_denial or code_claim match when the text right before it (spaces trimmed) matches negation_before.

S5 compare, per fact, in this order: (1) a fact that satisfies a row.unresolved touches predicate emits only conflicting_official_wording; (2) otherwise test the row's misread_triggers in array order, first hit wins; (3) otherwise generic rules against the resolved track's cmp: lifetime vs duration one_time / months, or recurring vs duration one_time → duration_overstated; recurring vs duration months → duration_overstated only when no commission duration was extracted; a commission duration or cookie window is compared only when cmp has months / cookie_days (longer than cmp.months → duration_overstated, equal → matched, otherwise fact_mismatch); cash vs reward_form credit → credit_as_cash; a flat value equal to rate_max / amount_max where *_is_ceiling, or a flat amount equal to an amount_caps entry → ceiling_as_floor; a ceiling-marked value on a track whose *_is_ceiling is true and that differs from *_max → fact_mismatch; a ceiling-marked amount equal to an amount_caps entry → matched; a threshold fact equal to cmp.threshold → matched, any other threshold fact → fact_mismatch; a value in cmp (or within its range, or a range whose ends are both published) → matched; a value found only in another track's cmp → track_conflated; anything else → fact_mismatch.

S6 status short-circuit for rows whose status is not open (S3–S5 are skipped; their misread_triggers apply only if the row reopens): closed → program_closed; capped_and_geo → referral_cap + geo_excluded; geo_restricted → geo_excluded.

S7 whole-paste lexicon checks: code_claim or private_rate → private_terms, and discard that program's S5 results (the numbers describe the private offer); income → income_claim; affiliation → claimed_affiliation; guarantee → guarantee_claimed.

S8 label = the highest-precedence label among emitted codes. reason_codes = the emitted codes carrying that label, de-duplicated, in the key order of reason_codes. 公开规则 · rule_match only when the row is open and not stale, at least one fact matched, no fact contradicted, and nothing else fired. Nothing fired and nothing matched → 未核实 · no_checkable_fact.
classifier.per_row_not_global: Judge every keyword against the matched row. Kinsta publishes 10% recurring for the lifetime of the customer's paid plan, so a claim tying “lifetime” to the plan is 公开规则 there, while “refer once, earn forever” is 易误解. Lifetime wording is 易误解 for HubSpot, Framer and ElevenLabs, and for Kit's 50% (first 12 months only); Kit's conditional 10–20% after month 12 for status-holding affiliates is its published rule.

program_closed.label: 关门反例
program_closed.zh: 该项目目前不接受新成员。
program_closed.en: This program is not accepting new members.

referral_cap.label: 关门反例
referral_cap.zh: 官方设有推荐人数或奖励上限。
referral_cap.en: The official terms cap referrals or rewards.

geo_excluded.label: 关门反例
geo_excluded.zh: 官方条款排除了部分地区或账户类型，并非人人可参与。
geo_excluded.en: The official terms exclude some regions or account types; not everyone can take part.

duration_overstated.label: 易误解
duration_overstated.zh: 官方条款写明是一次性或有期限，不是终身循环。
duration_overstated.en: The official terms are one-time or time-limited, not lifetime recurring.

ceiling_as_floor.label: 易误解
ceiling_as_floor.zh: 官方数额是上限或最高档位，不是每单固定值。
ceiling_as_floor.en: The official figure is a maximum or a top tier, not a fixed amount per sale.

reward_misattributed.label: 易误解
reward_misattributed.zh: 文中所说的奖励归被推荐人所有，或本就出自推荐人自己的返佣比例，并非额外所得。
reward_misattributed.en: The reward described goes to the referred person, or already comes out of the referrer's own share; it is not extra.

credit_as_cash.label: 易误解
credit_as_cash.zh: 奖励是平台内抵扣额或积分，不是现金。
credit_as_cash.en: The reward is platform credit, not cash.

track_conflated.label: 易误解
track_conflated.zh: 把不同计划或渠道（如联盟、客户推荐、合作伙伴计划，或中国站与国际站）的条款混在了一起。
track_conflated.en: Mixes terms from different programs or channels (such as affiliate, referral and partner programs, or China-site and international terms).

stale_terms.label: 易误解
stale_terms.zh: 引用的是旧版条款，现行规则已变更。
stale_terms.en: Cites superseded terms; the current rule differs.

conditions_omitted.label: 易误解
conditions_omitted.zh: 省略了官方列明的前提（须为付费套餐、仅限新客、代扣税款、分阶段发放、折扣限制等）。
conditions_omitted.en: Leaves out conditions in the official terms (such as a paid plan, new customers only, tax withholding, staged payouts or discount limits).

guarantee_claimed.label: 易误解
guarantee_claimed.zh: 官方公开条款不保证任何收益。
guarantee_claimed.en: The official terms do not guarantee any earnings.

fact_mismatch.label: 易误解
fact_mismatch.zh: 与本站整理的官方公开规则不一致。
fact_mismatch.en: Does not match our summary of the program's official public terms.

private_terms.label: 未核实
private_terms.zh: 私下费率、内部码或「特批」无法从公开条款核实。
private_terms.en: Private rates, “internal codes” or special tiers can't be verified from public terms.

income_claim.label: 未核实
income_claim.zh: 个人收入、截图或战绩无法核实。
income_claim.en: Personal income claims and screenshots can't be verified.

claimed_affiliation.label: 未核实
claimed_affiliation.zh: 自称与项目方有特殊关系，公开信息无法核实。
claimed_affiliation.en: A claimed special relationship with the vendor can't be verified from public information.

conflicting_official_wording.label: 未核实
conflicting_official_wording.zh: 官方页面对此表述不一致，或只见于第三方、官方未确认，暂不下结论。
conflicting_official_wording.en: The official pages disagree on this point, or only third parties state it, so we can't give a verdict yet.

no_checkable_fact.label: 未核实
no_checkable_fact.zh: 说法里没有可对照的具体条款。
no_checkable_fact.en: The claim contains no checkable term.

seed_stale.label: 未核实
seed_stale.zh: 本站对该项目的记录尚未对照官方原页复核，或已超过复核期限，暂不判断。
seed_stale.en: Our entry for this program hasn't been checked against the official page recently enough to judge this claim.

unknown_program.label: 未核实
unknown_program.zh: 该项目尚未收录，本站暂无其官方条款可供对照。
unknown_program.en: This program isn't on our board yet, so we have nothing from its official terms to compare against.

rule_match.label: 公开规则
rule_match.zh: 与本站整理的官方公开规则一致。
rule_match.en: Matches our summary of the program's official public terms.

lexicon._note: JS regex sources, flags iu, run on the S0-normalized segment. Bracketed forms such as 稳[赚] match the plain word in a paste while keeping this file clean under acceptance A1. The lexicon is a living list: add a phrasing only together with a regression-corpus case (acceptance A12).
lexicon.lifetime: 终身|终生|永续|无限期|永久|一辈子|永远|\blifetime\b(?!\s+deal)|\bforever\b|\bfor life\b|in perpetuity
lexicon.plan_tied: 套餐(?:持续|存续|付费|有效)|只要(?:客户|用户|对方)?(?:一直|持续|继续|还在|在)?(?:续费|付费|订阅)|续费就|(?:客户|用户)?不(?:退订|取消|流失)|持续付费|付费期间|续费期间|as long as|keeps? paying|while (?:the )?customer|of (?:the|their) plan
lexicon.recurring: 循环|月月[返拿分有]|每个?月都(?:能|会|可以?)?[返拿分有]|续费[也都]?(?:返|有|计佣|分成)|recurring|every month|each month
lexicon.ceiling: 最高|至高|可达|高达|至多|最多|(?<!无|没有|不设)上限|(?<!不)封顶|up to|as much as|capped at|cap of|\bmax(?:imum)?\b(?: of)?
lexicon.threshold: 满|起付|起提|最低提现|提现门槛|门槛|超过|minimum(?: payout| balance| withdrawal)?(?: of)?|threshold(?: of)?|at least|exceeds?
lexicon.threshold_after: ^\s*(?:起提|起付|起结|起兑|即可提现|才(?:能|可以?)?(?:提现|提|打款|结算)|提现门槛|门槛|minimum(?: payout| withdrawal| balance)?\b|min\.? (?:payout|withdrawal)|payout (?:threshold|minimum))
lexicon.per_unit: 每单|每个|一单|每人|每位|每拉|per (?:sale|signup|sign-up|referral|customer|order|client)
lexicon.timing_after: ^\s*(?:后|以后|之后|after\b|later\b)|^[^、;。!?]{0,8}?(?:待定|生效|到账|审核|结算|冻结|考核|锁定|发放|付款|打款|支付|注册|下单|首购|首单|购买|确认|提现|pending|hold|period|approval|qualif|validat|lock)
lexicon.timing_before: (?:after|within)\s*$|(?:待定|生效|到账|审核|结算|冻结|考核|锁定|发放|等待|pending|hold|approval)[^、;。!?\d]{0,3}$
lexicon.cookie: cookie|归因|关联期|追踪|跟踪|referral window|attribution|tracking (?:window|period)|click window
lexicon.friend_gets: (?:好友|朋友|对方(?:公司|企业)?|被推荐人|被邀请人|被(?:推荐|邀请)的?(?:公司|企业|客户|商家))(?:也|还|可|能|会)*(?:拿|得|获|领|送|返|有)|\b(?:friend|referee|invitee)s?\s+(?:also\s+)?(?:gets?|receives?|earns?)
lexicon.signup_pays: 注册(?:就|即|也|都)(?:能|可以?|会)?(?:算|有|拿|给|返|得)|every sign-?up|each sign-?up|per sign-?up
lexicon.instant: 秒到|立即到账|马上(?:到账|能卖|有)|当月到账|(?:paid|pays?|payouts?|payments?|commissions?|starts?|begins?|kicks? in|arrives?)\s+(?:out\s+)?(?:instantly|immediately|right away)|instant\s+(?:pay(?:outs?|ments?)?|commissions?|cash(?:out)?|withdrawals?)|from day one
lexicon.stack: 叠加|双份|两份|同时拿|\bstack(?:s|ed|ing)?\b|on top of
lexicon.cap_denial: 上不封顶|不封顶|无上限|不设上限|没有上限|不限(?:人数|名额|次数|数量)|无限(?:推荐|邀请|拉人)|unlimited\s+(?:referrals?|invites?|rewards?|earnings?)|\bno\s+(?:referral\s+)?(?:limit|cap)\b|uncapped
lexicon.code_claim: 内部码|创始人码|专属码|领取码|私信(?:我|本人)?(?:领取|领|拿|要|获取)(?!取?\s*(?:链接|link))|founder code|internal code|secret code|exclusive code|dm me (?:for|to get) (?:the |my |an? )?(?:code|rate|invite)
lexicon.private_rate: 内部价|内部渠道|特批|私下|私域价|vip ?(?:rate|tier)|negotiated|special tier|private rate
lexicon.income: (?:月|日)入(?=\s*[\d一二两三四五六七八九十百千万过破上])|收入截图|战绩|躺[赚]|被动收入|睡后收入|躺着(?:赚|收|拿|数)钱|\bi (?:made|earned) (?:\$|usd ?)?\d|per month income|passive income|(?:earnings?|income|payouts?|commissions?|revenue)\s+screenshots?|screenshots?\s+of\s+(?:my\s+)?(?:earnings?|income|payouts?|commissions?|dashboard)
lexicon.guarantee: 稳[赚]|保赚|包赚|必赚|年入百[万]|零风险|无风险|0\s*风险|guaranteed|risk[- ]free|sure thing
lexicon.affiliation: 官方合[作](?!伙伴(?:计划|项目))|官方授权|官方指定|official partner(?!s?\s+program)|authorized by|endorsed by
lexicon.negation_before: (?:不是|并非|并不|非|没有|无|不|别|不能|不可以?|无法|不得|不会)$|(?:^|[^a-z])(?:not|no|never|nothing|isn['’]t|aren['’]t|can['’]t|cannot|won['’]t|don['’]t|doesn['’]t|without|non-?)(?:\s+(?:be|is|are|a|an))?(?:\s+(?:withdrawn|redeemed|exchanged|converted|paid out)\s+(?:as|for|into))?$
lexicon.exclusion_stated: 不计佣|不计入|不算|不能|不可|不另|不再|不适用|不包括|不含|除外|排除|没有佣金|no longer|not (?:eligible|count|counted|paid|commissionable|the same)|(?:don't|doesn't|do not|does not) (?:count|pay|earn|qualify|apply)|earns? nothing|excluded|isn't|is not|pays? (?:\$\s*)?0\b|零佣金

track_words.friend_referral: 推荐好友|邀请好友|推荐码|邀请码|refer[- ]a[- ]friend|friend referral|referral code|refer (?:&|and) earn
track_words.solutions_partner: solutions? partner|解决方案(?:合作)?伙伴
track_words.invite_earn: invite (?:&|and) earn|邀请(?:有礼|计划)|积分
track_words.llm_line: 大模型|\bllms?\b|\bagents?\b|智能体|通义|百炼|qwen

match_grammar._note: A trigger or unresolved item fires when every condition in its object holds for the program's segment. null = documentation only, never fires.
match_grammar.lex_none: none of the listed lexicon keys matched
match_grammar.re: this regex source (flags iu) matches the segment
match_grammar.rate / amount: that value was extracted as a standalone fact (not inside a range)
match_grammar.flat: true → that rate/amount has no ceiling marker in the 8 characters before it
match_grammar.rate_gt / amount_lt: some standalone rate is greater / amount is smaller than the value
match_grammar.amount_between: some standalone amount lies strictly between the two values
match_grammar.amount_in: some standalone amount equals one of the values
match_grammar.cookie_days (in touches): also matches when the value is extracted as a cookie/association window
match_grammar.cookie_days: the extracted cookie window equals the value (days)
match_grammar.months: the extracted commission duration equals the value (months)

cmp_grammar._note: Per-track comparator. null on rows whose status is not open (S6 short-circuits them).
cmp_grammar.rates / amounts: published per-sale values; a range endpoint counts as published
cmp_grammar.rate_max / amount_max + *_is_ceiling: the published figure is a ceiling ('up to') or top tier
cmp_grammar.months: commission duration in months when duration includes months
cmp_grammar.amount_caps: published caps (per order, per customer or per period): a flat amount equal to one → ceiling_as_floor, a ceiling-marked one → matched
cmp_grammar.threshold: published minimum (payout balance or qualifying order); compared only with threshold facts

output_contract.source_url: the resolved track's source, or tracks[0].source; null for unknown_program
output_contract.as_of: row.verified_on; while null (seed_stale) render 待核对官方原页 / Not yet checked against the official page instead of a date; null for unknown_program
output_contract.render: In [data-region="verdict"], per program: program name (row.name.zh, row.name.en on the muted line) → label chip (zh + en gloss) → one fixed zh/en line per reason code → source link whose visible text is the fixed string 官方来源 / Official source (URL only in href, data-field="source_url") → 核对日期 / Checked + as_of (data-field="as_of"). No numerals anywhere in the verdict except inside data-field="as_of"; the paste is never quoted or paraphrased; no join CTA in the verdict.

share_line.offer_when: label = 公开规则 AND row.status = open AND the row is not stale; never on 易误解 / 未核实 / 关门反例

template.zh: {program_zh}（公开计划）· 官方条款：{official_url}（{as_of} 核对）· 我的推荐链接：{own_link} ｜ 推荐 · 可能获佣 / may earn a rebate
template.en: {program_en} (public program) · official terms: {official_url} (checked {as_of}) · my referral link: {own_link} | 推荐 · 可能获佣 / may earn a rebate

share_line.slots: {program_zh} / {program_en} = row.name.zh / row.name.en; {official_url} = the resolved track's source; {as_of} = row.verified_on. {own_link} is typed by the user and starts empty: exactly one http(s) URL, no whitespace, up to 300 characters. Any other input shows 请填写你自己的链接 / Enter your own link and the copy button stays disabled. The instrument never pre-fills, suggests, shortens or rewrites it, and never inserts a code.
share_line.region: The share line renders in [data-region="share"], outside the verdict; its date carries data-field="as_of".

llm_line.zh: 中国站大模型 / Agent 产品线

board.rows: Status and checked date once per row; one sub-line per track with its track label and that track's source link (data-field="source_url", visible text 官方来源 / Official source).
board.row_cta: Only when status = open and the row is not stale: one plain official URL (row.join_cta, no query params) rendered as <a data-cta="join"> labelled 官方页 / Official page. Any other row renders no element with data-cta.
board.stale_rendering: A row whose verified_on is null or older than 90 days (same clock as S2) shows the 待核对 Unconfirmed chip in place of its status and no data-cta element. acceptance: A1 Hype grep: `LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 grep -rnE '稳[赚]|年入百[万]|官方合[作]' .` over the repo, this spec, copy and the built output returns nothing (exit 1); no directory is excluded. The bracket form keeps this spec clean under its own grep; test pastes that need one of the three terms store its last character as a JSON \u escape (U+8D5A, U+4E07, U+4F5C) or build it at runtime.

A2 Closed rows: `document.querySelectorAll('[data-status]:not([data-status="open"]) [data-cta]').length === 0`, stale rows likewise render no data-cta, and every seed row whose status is not open has join_cta = null (notion, ibkr-friend-referral, binance-fee-share).

A3 No take-rate: for the 5 fixtures and a 200-paste fuzz corpus, the text of [data-region="verdict"] minus [data-field="as_of"] contains no [0-9０-９] and no match for /你能[拿赚]|you('ll| will| can| could) (earn|make|get|receive)/i.

A4 No codes: no shipped file, and no rendered DOM outside the paste box and the user-typed value of {own_link}, matches /[?&](ref|via|code|invite|aff|referral)=/i; {own_link} renders empty until typed and is never pre-filled, suggested or rewritten.

A5 Share line: every rendered share line contains the exact substring “推荐 · 可能获佣 / may earn a rebate”; share lines appear only under share_line.offer_when (fixture F1 yes; F2–F5 no); the copy button is disabled while {own_link} is empty or invalid.

A6 Fixtures: with an injected clock and the matched row set to page_read = true, verified_on = clock − 1 day, and the seed otherwise as shipped, all 5 fixtures return exactly their expect.label and expect.reason_codes; with verified_on = null, each returns 未核实 · seed_stale.

A7 Seed integrity: 15 rows; each has at least one official source URL per track, extracted_on, evidence and confidence. Launch is blocked until every row has page_read = true and a verified_on; CI and the client both apply the stale rendering to any row whose verified_on is more than 90 days old.
A8 Determinism and privacy: the same paste on the same seed and date run 100 times gives identical output; after page load, pasting fires zero network requests.
A9 Bilingual: every UI string key has non-empty zh and en; label chips always show the zh label plus the en gloss.
A10 Look: all text including label chips is WCAG AA (≥ 4.5:1) on its surface; no horizontal scroll at 360px; no animation beyond the 150ms fade.
A11 Identity: not served from gravity.li; no GRAVITY or vendor logos; the standing disclosure appears on every view.

A12 Regression corpus: CI runs a paste → expected label / reason_codes corpus of at least 300 zh and en pastes (seeded with the 5 fixtures and the drafting stress cases: viral zh formatting, spelled-out numbers, ranges, thresholds, cookie vs commission vs payout-timing durations, negations, stated exclusions, multi-program lists, alias collisions). Every lexicon, cmp, trigger or step change must keep it green, and every newly found misclassification is added to it before the fix.
